FY2026 매출이 FY2024보다 얼마나 증가했는지 설명해줘.

root = Card([
  CardHeader("NVIDIA FY2026 Revenue Increase Explanation", "Based on Fiscal Year Revenue Data"),
  TextContent("NVIDIA's revenue for Fiscal Year 2026 was $215.9 billion, up from $60.9 billion in Fiscal Year 2024. This represents an increase of approximately 254% over the two-year period. The revenue more than tripled from FY2024 to FY2026, reflecting strong growth and demand."),
  Callout("info", "Calculation", "Percentage increase calculated as ((FY2026 - FY2024) / FY2024) * 100 = ((215,938 - 60,922) / 60,922) * 100 ≈ 254%. Figures are in million USD.")
])
